items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: We had a piano player. We call him Blind Jack... pick him up on jobs every night

ctx.x: Now we had another thing that you won't find very often. We had a piano player. We call him Blind Jack. He's blind. Jack, he didn't play with a steady, but pick him up on jobs every night and things like that. Spot jobs. He's the only man that's ever been known to do it when he's going to tell you. He'd leave his home. You tell him, it would be so-and-so, number so-and-so, how so-and-so. And meet up at 8 o'clock, Jack, all right, all right. He's the only man that's ever been known. He can go out to, he can go out…
Some guys just have that. I guess it's an instinct or something. Yeah. Anyway, what kind of jobs did y'all play at that band? Did you play steady dance work?

items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: We used to call him Fort Bell.

ctx.x: He worked as a guy with one of his names. What was that real name? We used to call him Fort Bell.
Well, I'll ask somebody wearing Whirlines. They might remember him.
